body:
Sentinel Real Estate has acquired Hearthstone Investments, a U.K.-based investment manager specializing in affordable private rental housing. The acquisition builds on Sentinel’s formal entry into the United Kingdom in January 2026 and marks another important step in the growth of its global residential platform. The Hearthstone team will be integrated into Sentinel’s global business.

The transaction combines Sentinel’s international residential investment and operating experience with Hearthstone’s established U.K. team, institutional relationships and nationwide portfolio. It gives Sentinel a strong foundation to pursue further opportunities across the U.K. living sector.
